focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文破题首段：具象趋势锚定 + 争议张力 + 明确中心论点（Zero-Template Hook & Thesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Concrete Phenomenon (No Cliché) -> Balanced Tension -> Conditional & Specific Thesis Statement. 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 汇集了中国考生三大扣分重灾区：① With the rapid development of...；② more and more popular / good vs. bad；③ Every coin has two sides（零立场的废话中心论点）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Large language models and automated code assistants have rapidly become routine study aids across university campuses. While proponents contend that these tools accelerate literature synthesis and lower programming barriers, critics warn that unchecked reliance erodes students' capacity for independent problem formulation. In my view, universities should integrate generative tools into advanced coursework only after students master foundational analytical skills, as premature delegation weakens debugging competence and obscures underlying mathematical principles.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 全局总括与新增实验汇总段（Author Rebuttal General Response）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [致谢并提炼审稿人共同好评 Gratitude & Shared Praise]：We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our work's [Quote Reviewer 1 Praise] (R1), [Quote Reviewer 2 Praise] (R2), and [Quote Reviewer 3 Praise] (R3).

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Synthesize Reviewer Praise -> Announce Concrete Revisions -> Numbered Evidence Bullets mapped to Reviewers -> Courteous Hook. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Thank you to all reviewers for your time and comments. We have carefully read your reviews and answered all your questions below. We hope you can raise your scores.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 空洞客套且直接讨要分数（hope you can raise your scores），没有在第一眼展示任何新增实证工作量。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our framework's 'principled formulation of the stationarity-amplitude trade-off' (R1, R3), 'strong empirical gains across eight benchmarks' (R2), and 'clear ablation design' (R4). To address your valuable suggestions, we conducted four sets of new experiments during the rebuttal period (incorporated in blue in the revised manuscript): (1) Benchmarked against two latest 2025 foundation models, Chronos and MOIRAI, across all horizons (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Added real-robot grasping evaluations under dynamic lighting and 25% camera occlusion (Section 4.5, R2); and (3) Included full GPU memory and wall-clock latency scaling curves up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R4). Below we address each reviewer's specific questions in detail.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 核心正方分论点段：主张 -> 机制推演 -> 具象行业微案例 -> 扣题闭环（PEEL 满分段）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 议论文核心主体段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [分论点主题句 Topic Claim]：一句话清晰亮出本段唯一控制中心（[Policy/Factor X] strengthens [Outcome Y] by [Core Mechanism]）。
S2 [因果机制推演 Causal Elaboration]：Explain HOW and WHY：阐明如果没有这层干扰或有了这项机制，认知/经济/技术流程会发生什么具体改变。
S3 [具象微观案例 Concrete Micro-Case]：For instance, when [Specific Group/Industry] [Specific Action], [Measurable/Observable Consequence]（绝不编造假百分比，用具体场景细节说话）。
S4 [反事实对比或扣题升华 Warrant / Link Back]：Thus, [Summary Noun] shifts human effort from [Low-value Routine] toward [High-value Judgment].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Topic Claim -> Causal Mechanism -> Concrete Micro-Case (L021) -> Warrant Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L006, L012, L021.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: First, AI can improve working efficiency a lot. People have many boring tasks every day. If AI does these tasks, people can save time and do better things. For example, my friend uses AI to write emails and saves two hours every day. So AI is very helpful.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 口语词泛滥（a lot, boring tasks, better things, my friend）；② 个人化琐碎举例（my friend saves two hours）不符合学术议论文语域。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Delegating repetitive data compilation to automated systems enables professionals to concentrate on high-level diagnostic judgment. In data-intensive fields such as clinical medicine and structural engineering, practitioners traditionally spend hours cross-checking routine telemetry logs before formulating a hypothesis. When hospital radiology departments deploy automated screening algorithms to flag normal chest scans, physicians can redirect their cognitive bandwidth toward ambiguous pathology cases and patient consultation. Consequently, intelligent triage elevates both diagnostic throughput and clinical care quality.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 延续链式推进模式（Linear Chain Progression）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 阐述因果机制、算法推导或仿真到真实迁移（Sim-to-Real）链条时，严格采用 A -> B，B -> C，C -> D 的咬合结构，上一句的宾语转化为下一句的主语。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: S1: A induces B. -> S2: This B distorts C. -> S3: Once C degrades, D collapses.
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 中间跳过关键传导环节（如直接从 A 跳到 D），或者链条顺序颠倒。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Unmodeled friction in simulated joints causes real-world grasping failure. Domain randomization often fails because state transitions diverge.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Unmodeled joint friction in simulators creates a systematic discrepancy between synthetic and physical state transitions. This transition mismatch misleads visuomotor policies during contact-rich phases, ultimately causing real-world grasping failures.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 通过 synthetic and physical state transitions -> This transition mismatch -> contact-rich phases -> grasping failures 形成严密的四环机械传导链。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 段落内主语瘦身与尾重平衡（Subject Compression & End-Weight）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在多句段落中，严禁出现超过 10–12 个单词的臃肿主语从句或连环 of 短语作主语（头重脚轻）。把已知的短核心名词放在主语位置（≤6 词），将复杂的条件、机制和结果顺延到谓语动词之后的宾语或状语从句中。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Bad: [The phenomenon that A with B under C fails to D] is common. -> Good: [Short Subject A] frequently fails to [Verb D] when [Condition B and C occur].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 受中文“……的现象/问题/事实表明……”影响，写出 The fact that... is... 或 The problem of the degradation of... is... 的畸形句。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The phenomenon that autoregressive language models hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries is a serious obstacle.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Autoregressive language models frequently hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries, posing a serious obstacle to automated literature review.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 主语从 17 个词压缩为 3 个词（Autoregressive language models），强动词 hallucinate 提前，句尾用分词结果状语自然收束。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L003 延续链式推进模式（Linear Chain Progression））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 汇集了中国考生三大扣分重灾区：① With the rapid development of...；② more and more popular / good vs. bad；③ Every coin has two sides（零立场的废话中心论点）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

While proponents contend that these tools accelerate literature synthesis and lower programming barriers, critics warn that unchecked reliance erodes students' capacity for independent problem formulation. In my view, universities should integrate generative tools into advanced coursework only after students master foundational analytical skills, as premature delegation weakens debugging competence and obscures underlying mathematical principles.

focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想说明：把我们的核心思想落地时遇到了两个具体工程/数学难点，我们分别设计了什么精巧机制去攻克它们。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: There are two challenges. The first challenge is that noise is big. We use a filter. The second challenge is that speed is slow. We use distillation.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L023 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 全部是散装幼稚短句（is big, is slow, We use...），毫无学术机制深度。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Consider a multivariate time series $\mathbf{X}_{1:L} = [x_1, \dots, x_L]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$ recording $C$ correlated sensors over lookback horizon $L$. Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$. Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.
